title: foam
body:
## foam

Curated OpenFOAM reader: opens a case through its .foam marker file and outputs a multiblock dataset whose blocks are the selected mesh regions (internalMesh volume cells, patch/<name> boundaries) carrying the selected cell fields, with one time step per stored time directory. Schemaxis defaults read a decomposed case (processor* folders), only internalMesh, and keep the 0 directory; other reader settings keep ParaView's defaults, which also create point data interpolated from the cell fields. Use pvOpenFOAMReader for point or Lagrangian fields, zones, label/scalar size or the other native options.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- caseType defaults to Decomposed Case in Schemaxis (ParaView's own default is Reconstructed Case); for a serial or reconstructed case set Reconstructed Case, otherwise the reader finds no data.
- Boundary patches are loaded only when listed in regions as patch/<name>.
- Pick stored times with the document's times selection using this node as the source.

Native constructor: `OpenFOAMReader`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | Choose the path and filename of a .foam marker in your OpenFOAM case folder, for example /data/coupe/coupe.foam. The marker can be empty: its parent folder contains the actual mesh and time directories. Absolute paths are accepted. Relative paths are resolved from the directory where Studio was launched, not from the JSON file folder. Browse inserts an absolute path; the dataset stays in place and is not uploaded or copied. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"type":"string","minLength":1}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `caseType` | Choose Decomposed Case when the results remain in processor0, processor1 and other processor folders. Choose Reconstructed Case for a serial case or results reconstructed into the main case folder. Match the layout of the data you want to read. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Decomposed Case","Reconstructed Case"]}` | `"Decomposed Case"` | `"Decomposed Case"` |
| `regions` | Mesh regions to load. internalMesh is the volume mesh; add boundary patches with the reader's prefixed names, e.g. "patch/inlet" or "patch/walls", when you also want those surfaces. Names must match regions available in your case. Omitting this setting loads internalMesh. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1}` | `["internalMesh"]` | `["internalMesh"]` |
| `cellArrays` | Names of cell fields to read, for example U for velocity, p for pressure, or nut for turbulent viscosity. Names depend on your case. This selects existing fields; it does not calculate new ones. If omitted, Schemaxis leaves the reader’s field selection at its native default. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":1}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `skipZero` | Enable this to skip the initial time directory 0 when reading available times. Leave it disabled when you want to inspect the initial conditions as well as later results. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "foam",
  "options": {
    "file": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
